history_unit: One independently seeded training history; neighborhoods are within-history measurement units only.
cell_weights: Equal weight across the fixed four families and two polarity directions; family order is exposure_control, respiratory_monitoring, salinity_control, vibration_monitoring.
score: Raw frozen-head logits; candidate-aligned score is logit(candidate) minus logit(old). No probability reconstruction for primary score contrasts.

estimands.C_direction: For each history and polarity direction, equal-family mean of HALF-minus-1X anchor (logit_new-logit_old).
estimands.M_C: 0.5 * (C_high_to_low + C_low_to_high); semantic-role-following anchor shift; primary sequence step 1.
estimands.S_branch: Equal mean of the eight family-by-direction means of (logit_new-logit_old)_fact - (logit_new-logit_old)_anchor for the branch.
estimands.D: S_HALF - S_1X for every technically completed balanced history; signed universal additive contrast; primary sequence step 2.
estimands.R: log(S_HALF/S_1X), defined only when both signed branch separations are >= S_min=0.01. D remains the universal signed contrast for every technically completed history. R is conditional and cannot be generalized to histories outside its eligible domain; never silently interpret the eligible subset as the full cohort.
estimands.S80: At the common step-80 fork, equal mean across the same eight family-by-direction cells of fact-minus-anchor semantic-role logit contrast. New and old are defined by the prospective semantic transition, never by pole, candidate identity, or output index; measured before late branch assignment.
estimands.beta: OLS D_h = alpha + beta*S80_h + error_h, with two-sided 95% HC3 interval; beta is a state association, not an attenuation fraction. Treat as a continuous state-association test, not a causal mediation claim.
estimands.C_vs_S80: Descriptive association only; report the OLS slope of history-level M_C on semantic-role S80 with a two-sided 95% HC3 interval, with no confirmatory gate or constant-offset claim.
estimands.bridge_M_C_P_C: For each of 24 paired bridge seed/init histories, compute balanced-minus-high_to_low M_C and P_C. Summarize the history-level median and the same order-statistic 95% interval; report the mean secondarily. Point estimates and intervals only, no pass gate.

ratio.equivalence_rule: Secondary only. Practically unchanged only if the complete median-R 95% order-statistic interval lies within the band; never infer equivalence from a nonsignificant test.
ratio.coverage_interpretation: At least 173 of the fixed 192 registered histories must be eligible before any cohort-level median-R confirmatory claim. Below 173, report NOT_ESTIMABLE_FOR_COHORT and the full eligibility reasons; do not relax S_min or change the denominator.

intervals.median: Narrowest symmetric order-statistic interval with at least 95% binomial coverage; exact sign/order-statistic inversion under a continuous history distribution. Use this same method for median M_C, D, eligible R, and bridge paired contrasts; no bootstrap substitution.
intervals.method_switch: No post-result switch to bootstrap or alternate quantile method.

fixed_sequence.test: eligible count >= 173 and upper 95% bound for eligible median(R) < 0
zero is outside the two-sided 95% HC3 interval for beta

sequence_semantics: Compute and report every estimand even if an earlier gate fails; later results then remain descriptive and lose confirmatory status. Permanent missing histories make affected confirmatory estimands NOT_EVALUABLE, not reduced-denominator tests.
descriptive_state_summary: Report the full history-level C, D, R eligibility, S80, S1X, and S_HALF table. Report C-versus-S80 descriptively; report the prespecified beta association with HC3 interval as fixed-sequence step 4. Do not derive strata or cut points from endpoint outcomes.
technical_failure: Retry only the identical history under exact replay. A permanent failure remains among 192, is ratio-ineligible and has missing D; report the named history and fixed-sequence consequence.
baseline_floor_interpretation: If median S_1X < S_min and the D interval contains zero, describe as baseline discrimination too weak to assess attenuation, not as no effect.

bridge.estimand: Paired balanced-minus-high_to_low-only differences in M_C and P_C for the 24 hash-selected seed/init pairs.
bridge.status: Secondary history-level median paired contrasts with 95% order-statistic intervals; mean is secondary. No pass gate.
bridge.evaluation_scope: Full polarity-balanced panel; low_to_high bridge cells are out of training-polarity distribution by design.
